meaning.en: (idiomatic) Sexual intercourse, especially a brief one.

sentences.vi: Nó mờ dần trong và ngoài.

sentences.en: It was going to be a hot day and she would be in and out of the car.

sentences.en: She watched vamps go in and out of the fortress.

sentences.en: From there the horse dashed in and out of the poles and came to a stop on his haunches.
